title: Emergency Break’s new single “HOMETOWN” is a deliberate exclamation from the heart
htmlContent:
Emergency Break has just released a powerful new single called “HOMETOWN,” which pulls listeners into the heartfelt emotions of frontman Leo Gerchen as he remembers the people and places he’s left behind. Written during a year in New York, Gerchen captures the bittersweet reflective feelings with a song that openly expresses these emotions.

“HOMETOWN” grabs your attention with its energetic sound and blend of deep thought and wild spirit. The lyrics convey feelings of longing and separation, while the music features driving guitars and strong drums combined with a vocal style. “I wanted to create a reflective track that also blasts through your headphones like our previous songs without holding back,” Gerchen explains. And that’s precisely what “HOMETOWN” provides.

https://open.spotify.com/track/6JVOXgxIoXxQSmnmGbYDpv?si=6d6ec2a46bd24700

This deeply reflects where we come from, how we move on, and what memories linger with us no matter how far we travel. With “HOMETOWN,” Emergency Break again shows that they have a skill for connecting with listeners in meaningful ways.
